title: Gartner: AI-generated Marketing Erodes Trust, Humans Sought for Recommendations
discussion_signal: The post interprets Gartner's consumer findings as selective distrust rather than blanket rejection of AI: people may accept convenience while relying more on real people for recommendations and becoming more skeptical of synthetic brand messages. Replies extend this into a low-trust-market and social-capital frame.
linked_research_question: How does AI-generated content change the signals consumers use to decide whether influencers, brands, and human recommendations are credible?
limits: Individual professional interpretation with selected replies
Survey figures are summarized rather than independently checked here
LinkedIn discussion is not a representative consumer sample
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
